name: TransThera Sciences (Nanjing), Inc.
summary: TransThera Sciences (Nanjing), Inc., clinical stage pharmaceutical company, discovers, develops, and commercializes small molecule therapies for oncology, inflammatory, and cardiometabolic diseases. The company provides Tinengotinib (TT-00420), a multi-kinase inhibitor that is in clinical stage for the treatment of recurrent or refractory drug-resistant solid tumors.
